dock(address,bytes32,address[]).details: Sets balances to 0 for all specified tokens

params.app: The app address associated with the strategy
params.strategyHash: The hash of the strategy being docked
params.tokens: Array of token addresses to clear

pull(address,bytes32,address,uint256,add.details: Decrements the balance and transfers tokens. Caller must be an approved app

params.maker: The maker to pull tokens from
params.strategyHash: The hash of the strategy being used

push(address,address,bytes32,address,uin.details: Transfers tokens from caller to maker and increases the app's balance

params.amount: The amount to push and add to balance
params.app: The address of the app/strategy receiving the tokens
params.maker: The maker whose balance receives the tokens
params.strategyHash: The hash of the strategy being pushed

params.app: The address of the app/strategy that can pull tokens
params.maker: The address of the maker who granted the balance
params.strategyHash: The hash of the strategy being used

returns.tokensCount: The number of tokens in the strategy

params.app: The address of the app/strategy that can pull tokens
params.maker: The address of the maker who granted the balances
params.strategyHash: The hash of the strategy being used
params.token0: The address of the first token
params.token1: The address of the second token

returns.balance0: The current balance amount for the first token
returns.balance1: The current balance amount for the second token

ship(address,bytes,address[],uint256[]).details: Parameter `strategy` is presented fully instead of being pre-hashed for data availability

params.amounts: Array of balance amounts for each token
params.strategy: Initialization data passed to the strategy
params.tokens: Array of token addresses to approve

dock(address,bytes32,address[]).notice: Docks (deactivates) a strategy by clearing balances for specified tokens

pull(address,bytes32,address,uint256,add.notice: Allows a strategy to pull tokens from a maker's wallet

push(address,address,bytes32,address,uin.notice: Pushes tokens and increases an app balance

rawBalances(address,address,bytes32,addr.notice: Returns the balance amount for a specific maker, app, and token combination

safeBalances(address,address,bytes32,add.notice: Returns balances of multiple tokens in a strategy, reverts if any of the tokens is not part of the active strategy

ship(address,bytes,address[],uint256[]).notice: Ships a new strategy as of an app and sets initial balances
